newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia frees olive oil prices for export.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia frees olive oil prices for export.

text.p: Leading olive oil exporter Tunisia on Friday said prices for exports of olive oil would be freed starting on Saturday.
Tunisia at the start of the olive oil season last November imposed a minimum price of 2,900 dinars to 2,450 dinars per tonne.
"All operators in the olive oil sector are informed that the minimum prices to export olive oil were freed starting May 10,' the Trade Ministry said in a statement.
Tunisia's olive oil exports amounted to 41.3 million dinars during the first quarter of 1997, against zero during the same period last year.
Output for the current season which started last November and ended in March was put at 250,000 tonnes after beneficial rainfall last year.

As of April 13, Tunisia had exported 22,471 tonnes since the start of the season, including 18,398 tonnes by the country's 18 private exporters and 4,072 tonnes by the state-controlled Office National de l'Huile (ONH).
The agriculture ministry said olive oil this year has an average acidity rate of one percent.
